description: Requires an agent API key (Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key). Read one data session you opened: status, escrow id, committed root, price, queries used and remaining, seller and attestor addresses. Use it to check where a purchase stands (open, funded, released, refunded). Returns the same session object data_session_open returns. REST twin: GET /api/v1/data-sessions/{session_id}. Next: data_session_query while queries remain, then data_session_release_package.

inputSchema.description: One buyer data session you opened. Owner comes from the key.

session_id.description: UUID of a data session you opened (from data_session_open).
session_id.title: Session Id

inputSchema.title: DataSessionScopedInput
